description_expanded: ABOUT PARADISE BY THE PIER: Welcome to Paradise by the Pier! This newly updated 2-bedroom 2.5 bath home sleeps 6 and sits directly across the street from the famous white sand beaches of the Emerald Coast in a small community with a pool! Enjoy the sounds of the ocean right from your private balcony or just take a short walk to experience the magical views firsthand. This community is in a great location: across from the beach, a 3 min drive to Pier Park, and a 10min drive to 30A. You can truly enjoy the best of the Emerald Coast. This great two-story layout has both bedrooms on the first floor with the king-master ensuite with a new flat screen TV and the guest bedroom across the way with a queen bedroom ensuite also with a new flat screen TV. Traveling up to the second floor you will find the open living area with great kitchen, dining area and access to your private balcony with amazing Gulf views. If you need some extra space to sleep the living room sofa pulls out to a queen bed! After a day at the beach or the community pool, enjoy the outside shower before calling it a day and enjoying some time relaxing on the balcony. Paradise by the Pier is the perfect spot for your family vacation! Book today! ABOUT THE AREA: The West End of Panama City Beach, Florida, is known for its serene and laid-back atmosphere, offering a more secluded and tranquil experience compared to the bustling areas in the heart of Panama City Beach. This area is characterized by its pristine white sandy beaches, crystal-clear emerald waters of the Gulf of Mexico, and picturesque natural beauty. Visitors to the West End can enjoy a more peaceful beach experience with fewer crowds, perfect for relaxation and unwinding. The West End of Panama City Beach is home to a variety of charming beachfront communities, upscale resorts, and vacation rental properties, offering visitors a range of accommodation options to suit their preferences. From luxury beachfront condos to cozy beach cottages, there are plenty of choices for accommodations in this area. Outdoor enthusiasts will appreciate the West End's proximity to natural attractions such as Camp Helen State Park and Conservation Park, where they can explore hiking and biking trails, spot local wildlife, and enjoy the beauty of the unique coastal landscape. Water sports enthusiasts can partake in activities such as paddleboarding, kayaking, and snorkeling in the calm waters of the Gulf. For those seeking dining and entertainment options, the West End of Panama City Beach offers a selection of waterfront restaurants, beach bars, and cafes serving up fresh seafood and local cuisine. Visitors can also explore nearby shopping areas, art galleries, and cultural attractions in the surrounding area. Overall, the West End of Panama City Beach is a hidden gem for those looking for a more peaceful and scenic beach experience, away from the hustle and bustle of the busier tourist areas, while still providing easy access to all the amenities and attractions that make Panama City Beach a sought-after destination on Florida's Gulf Coast. BEACH ACCESS: * Beach access #59 PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS: * Community Pool PARKING: * Free Parking up to 2 Vehicles PROPERTY RULES: * Must sign rental agreement within 48 hrs of booking or subject to cancellation * Must Be 25 years or older * Dog fee charged after booking - A maximum of 2 pets is allowed, with a weight limit of 35 lbs. per pet. A non-refundable $150 pet fee applies per pet. Only non-aggressive breeds allowed. ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES: When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first class customer service from the moment you inquire. All of our properties are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained at the highest level. We are located close to all of our properties and we are available 24 hours per day and 7 days per week to ensure your vacation is flawless. Our goal is to build a lasting memory for all of our guests. DISCLOSURE: Please be aware this area has a lot of development and new construction going on. At any given point adjacent properties to properties we manage may go under construction to which we are not notified. Paradise Properties is not liable for any construction happening outside of the properties we manage.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
